items.summary: ## Overview We have launched [OpenEval](https://github.com/adhabnr-ux/openeval) (v1.0.0-rc.1), an open standard (Apache 2.0) for portable LLM evaluation datasets. Every eval framework uses incompatible formats — OpenEval provides a standard JSON format + converters + SDKs (TypeScript + Python). ## What We're Proposing Add `to_openeval()` and `from_openeval()` methods (~50-100 lines using our SDK). ## Resources - **Spec:** https://github.com/adhabnr-ux/openeval/blob/main/spec/SPEC.md - **npm SDK:** `npm install @openeval/sdk` - **PyPI SDK:** `pip install openeval` We would love to collaborate.
